_why: ADR 0032's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
Together with adr-0026 (pH, temperature) and adr-0028 (buffers), this
completes the re-derivation of Lisa Jeske's sentence:
pH value, temperature, cofactors, and buffers play a huge role [...]
If you simply mix these together, the simulation will end up
Four things named; four checks; four tables now re-runnable rather than
asserted. That felt like the right unit to finish in one pass.
Both suites the ADR touches are run, per the rule ADR 0026's set file
taught: a narrower command than the record cites fabricates a NOT CAUGHT.

mutations.description: comparison_key ignores presence -- the motivating pair collapses
mutations._note: THE defect this module exists for. 'in the presence of FBP' and 'in the absence of FBP' are two arms of one designed experiment; a key that drops presence makes them the same condition and Terrium silently returns one arm.
